entries.213ac369d7adfeb8: A snack food manufacturer headquartered in Kita Ward, Tokyo. The company and five consolidated subsidiaries form the group, and consolidated employees as of the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 815. Listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.691a731b4764a03b: This is a reportable segment that leases real estate, such as rental housing, in Tokyo and other areas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥430 million.
entries.b6519e9aa0394229: This is a reportable segment in which the company and its consolidated subsidiaries manufacture and sell marine processed products, livestock meat processed products, dairy processed products, agricultural processed products, pocket confectionery products, chilled products and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥48,154 million, with the main product groups being marine processed products at ¥19,428 million, dairy processed products at ¥9,488 million and livestock meat processed products at ¥8,808 million.
entries.b7490504f93e403c: A food manufacturer that makes and sells snack foods such as Cheese Tara®, and also leases real estate.
